svg.aria-label: How Uptick works under the hood

g.text: Replays 30 days of swaps in every pool,
Picks the price range on the first 15 days
and tests it on the last 15.
Sizes each vault to at most 20% of the
One position each, in a band
Fees accrue to the share price.
Exit in kind is always open.
The app and agents read the same
Recentres each vault once a day, in a window starting at 02:00 UTC after the NYSE session,
and again when the price leaves the band for 30 minutes. It simulates every rebalance
before sending it, and anyone can rebalance a vault after 26 hours.
